Name: Sebastian Black Butler Dialogue Expansion
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
This mod has 2 parts (all in 1 file): a dialogue overhaul + expansion for Sebastian & a portrait/character sprite mod for Sebastian. 2 in 1! 

[size=5]IMPORTANT: [/size][b] if you have downloaded my original "Seasonal Black Butler Sebastian" mod (or any other sebastian portrait/sprite mod), please disable or delete it if you plan to use this mod. The reason is- this mod adds extra portraits (more expressions) than original sebastian would have, so their portrait expressions would not match up properly in the dialogue if you try to use any other portrait mod with this.  Remember: this mod is 2 in 1 ! Dialogue and character/portrait mod in one![/b]

[size=3]MAY 20th, 2025: [/size][size=2]Updated to fix some spelling errors, as well as change the extra NPC content. Now many more villagers will give you gifts on your birthday (fall 19)! And more NPC content in general. There are certainly more updates to come, (for spelling errors as well as more content. next I will be adding to the festivals for years 3+)

[/size]WANT TO SEE HOW IT LOOKS WITH GAMEPLAY? Check out my [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BzZB8EhHtl0]MOD SHOWCASE[/url] video on youtube <3

[size=4]LORE: [/size][size=2]If you are familiar with the anime 'Black Butler' then you will probably love this! If not, you may also love this if you're looking for a charming, sophisticated, taller + more handsome Sebastian who is also a demon that eats souls. Do you want to find out how Pelican Town reacts to a Demon joining the valley? Do you want to be woo'd by a dark creature of the night? look no further than this mod <3[/size]

[size=4]DIALOGUE EXPANSION:
[/size] ﻿- overhauls all of Sebastian's vanilla events (except for 6 heart event playing 'chronicles of solairs', I didn't touch that one yet but I could in a future update)
﻿- adds Y1 and Y2 specific lines to festivals for at least 4 extra NPC's per festival per year.
﻿- adds hundreds of extra lines to pre-marriage and post marriage sebastian
[size=3][i]
What To Expect from Sebastian's Dialogue:
[/i][/size][size=2]-Sebastian is now a Demon who arrived before you in Pelican Town. He rents out Robin's basement. You will learn about his purpose in town, his true nature, his contract with Sam and all of his lore as you play through this mod. 
[/size]-Sebastian is TOXIC!!!! (im a dark romance lover so I made Sebastian a darker MMC) what I mean by this is: He is overly protective/obsessed (once you get to know him a little bit better), he is controlling/jealous type at times, he is belittling of you (he's a demon and thinks humans are below him- of course, because he eats souls- and he will often belittle you and what he thinks of the human race)
-Sebastian will get SPICY! there is absolutely no profanity as I cannot imagine [i]Sebastian[/i] from [u]Black Butler[/u] swearing, but he is a sensual + DOMINATING type of man once you begin dating and play through marriage. Please scroll down and see some of the spoilers under "marriage" so that you can get a better idea of what I mean by this!
-Sebastian speaks with sophistication and holds himself above everyone else in many ways. I wanted to create a charming man yet one filled with secrets to uncover

[size=4]PORTRAITS + SPRITES:
[/size] ﻿-this is a SEASONAL portrait pack with special outfits for each festival!
﻿-Sebastian is taller, and 1 pixel wider making his more aesthetically pleasing beside your farmer.
﻿-Adds new expressions that my original release of "Black Butler Sebastian" doesn't have. These expressions have allowed me to have instances where (for example; Sebastian is shirtless talking to you at night (normal + flirty), laughing expression used often when belittling humans, anger and thinking expressions are separated and unique, and also adds a demonic smile)

[size=3]SPOILERS:[/size][size=2] Ive changed nicknames/player names to ####[/size]

[size=3]MARRIAGE[/size][size=2]:[/size]
[spoiler]EXAMPLE 1: "I trust you're feeling well after last night's... activities? // Oh, I beg to differ. I distinctly recall you being quite... eager. I believe you spent a fair amount of time on your knees, fervently seeking my approval. // Not what? You were quite persuasive, I must say. It's not every day I see my #### so... devoted to (his^her) cause. It seems you are discovering a new side to your ambitions." *small example of spiciness level. as you can see, no profanity, just alluding to intimate affairs and innuendos. It will get still a bit more dominating/demanding at times)[/spoiler]
[spoiler]EXAMPLE 2: (sebastian finds mayor Lewis' boxers and confronts player) "Ah, welcome home, ####. I trust your day was... eventful? // I see... And I couldn't help but notice something rather... intriguing while tidying up... [71] // Care to explain these? // 'Not what they seem'? Pray tell, whose are they? I didn't realize we were hosing guests of such... intimate nature. // So you're telling me they belong to the mayor? And you decided to bring them home and tailor them as your own? // I appreciate your honesty, my dear. It's just... you know how my mind tends to wander to darker places when it comes to a matter of trust. // Well I suppose I can forgive this little mishap, as long as you promise to get rid of these at once. I cannot have you walking around with another man's briefs. And please, keep me informed of any other quests that may send you into... unusual encounters in the future. // Now, shall we put this little incident behind us and enjoy the rest of our evening together?"[/spoiler]
[spoiler]EXAMPLE 3: "Look who decided to make a grand entrance. You're positively soaked, my #### // Indeed it is just rain but... you must realize that staying in those wet clothes is hardly wise. You'll catch a chill, and we wouldn't want you falling ill, now would we? // Ah but drying off can be quite the endeavour. Why not let me assist you? A warm bath would do wonders for your spirits- and your heath. // Allow me to take care of you, @. I promise to be gentle."[/spoiler]
[spoiler]EXAMPLE 4: "I have procured a selection of teas that may pique your interest. // Do you lean towards something floral, or do you prefer the rich, earthy tones of a quality oolong? // Ah, very well. My #### has a great sense of taste. Here you go, my Love. [614] // Sip it carefully for it is hot."[/spoiler]

[size=3]PRE-MARRIAGE:
[/size][spoiler]EXAMPLE 1: "Ah, a new resident in Pelican Town? How quaint. One must wonder what draws you to such a humble place"[/spoiler]
[spoiler]EXAMPLE 2: "Humans are quite curious within their set routines and unorthodox structure. It is perplexing to me. // They try to make things easier for themselves, but in reality, they're only making things harder. It's a self-inflicted paradox, a deliciously ironic cycle of self-destruction. I cannot seem to find the logic."[/spoiler][spoiler]EXAMPLE 3: "I have noticed, you tend to make waves whilst going about your buisness in town. It seems most residents are under your spell, and I'm not immune to your charms myself. You have a certain... allure that is quite irresistible."[/spoiler]
[spoiler]EXAMPLE 4: "I fear that Alex's brain may be injured from sports. His intellect is... limited, to say the least."[/spoiler]

[size=3]FESTIVAL:[/size]
[size=2][spoiler]EXAMPLE 1: (from Willie) "Aye, I've been tryin' to tell the others about Sebastian, but they just won't listen. // I saw him down by the lake, washin' a bloody shirt in the water. Aye, I'm not mistaken, (lad^lass), it was soaked in blood, and he was scrubbin' away at it like his life depended on it. // The lad's got a charm about him, I'll give him that, but I'm not buyin' it. Aye, I've been around the block a few times, and I can spot a scoundrel when I see one. // Sebastian's got 'scoundrel' written all over him, if ye ask me."[/spoiler][/size]
[size=2][spoiler]EXAMPLE 2: (from Sebastian) "Ah, the fortune teller's words still linger in my mind, a haunting whisper that our destinies are inextricably linked. // I warned you that getting close to me would cause our fates to become connected, didn't I? But, what is done is done. // It seems your sweet little soul is as good as mine. Just wait and see."[/spoiler][/size]
[size=2][spoiler]EXAMPLE 3: (from Gunther) "It's been a while, ####. I found some weird bones the other day near the mountains. Don't have the space for 'em in my collection though. Must have been a big animal though, the femur was the same size as mine!"[/spoiler][/size]

[size=4]FUTURE PLANS (for this mod):[/size]
[size=2]-I'm going to add more years worth of festival dialogue for the townsfolk, as well as more dialogue that comes from other NPC's in general. 
[/size]-I will eventually get around to doing another version of Sebastian's portraits. I just really <3 Black Butler and I would like to give you all a second version of our favourite Demon <3

[size=4]DO YOU LIKE MY WORK?
[/size]Leave a comment and let me know what you think! This is my first dialogue mod so also if there are any errors that you come across, let me know and I'll fix it right up! Any criticism/suggestions are surely welcome.
IM ALSO WORKING ON THESE THINGS:
﻿-A large Rug mod with 59 rugs total (7 colour ways,  7 varieties each) and the theme is cuter-but still will blend into vanilla- vibe. For CP and AT, I should have it ready on or before 19th.
﻿-A bed mod to match the rugs! 
﻿-Some other cute secret projects (if you love frogs you're gonna want to stick around for this!!)
﻿-More character revamps, using anime as inspiration (VINCENT/CIEL, other black butler characters, berserk characters, naruto etc)
﻿-Updating 'Morris is a Frog' to SVE. now that this dialogue is out I'll be working on this very soon

In doing so, I got to read all of the dialogue within that mod and it's wonderfully done! Really good take on Sebastian, he keeps his vanilla vibe but amps it up to a level that I know a lot of people would love. Here's the link to their mod <3 : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31398 
HUGE credit to AirynS with their 'Seasonal Outfits Code Template' which I used to make Sebastian's portraits and character sprites seasonal. They're also just very friendly and helpful, so thank you!! here is their mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14983?tab=description
HUGE credit to jellonip and their Romanceable Rasmodius Redox Revamped, I LOVE the way they made their character sprite for Magnus and I was inspired by their body shape of Magnus to create sebastian!

That's it! I hope you like this! I'll certainly be creating more dialogue content in the future. I have a few good ideas up my sleeve
